### 2026-10-10 – October 10: Finished the first steps of designing the Starbie.

**1.07h**

October 10: Finished the first steps of designing the Starbie.

I spent a lot of time researching and watching tutorials trying to understand how KiCad works. I think I got the hang of it. I was able to understand the wiring and all the different functions. I spent some time trying to figure out importing the symbol and footprint files for the XIAO, but I think it'll work...we'll see.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/247f05039c100c661f42a47adec0f73b004388c62f45a4676bb4ce8737e91e2a.png)

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/afc6bd2d-2bb3-4dbf-9bff-4f5dfebb2fbb/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-10 – October 10 (again):

**2.15h**

October 10 (again):
I finally finished the schematic! Then I created the star shape in the edge cuts layer and began routing the PCB. At this point I realized I made a mistake in the schematic editor so I went back into the schematic editor and fixed the wiring of the OLED. All of this is brand new to me so I had to search up a looot of stuff. I continued routing it and added a via had to route something from the B.Cu layer to the F.Cu layer. I also wasn't familiar with how to create vias so I had to search that up too.

I also added a ground pour (as directed in the Starbie Guide). After finishing all the routing, I ran a Design Rule Check and got an error message reading
"Error: Missing connection between items
Pad 13 [GND] of U2 on F.Cu
Zone [GND] on F.Cu and B.Cu, priority 0".
I had no idea how to fix this, but after researching I learned that I can just add a small wire from Pad 13 to the ground pour. This way, it physically links the ground fill zone to Pad 13.

I finished the rest of the routing and finally got to customize the board. I didn't want to add too much, so I imported some photos of my cat and chose my favorite. Then, I added a small text on the back.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/6c561add-802a-466c-b75a-251ddf93bbe7/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-11 – October 11: Started my repo and finalized my PCB design

**1h**

October 11: Started my repo and finalized my PCB design

I created a Github account, started making a Github repository with all my components and files. I had never used Github before, so I had to search for online tutorials on how to create a Github repository. This took quite a while and as I was writing my README, I realized I wanted a more accurate image of my PCB at the front. So, I readjusted some graphics the KiCad model and added the 3D components to it. Adjusting the orientation and position also took quite some time.

Here you can see I moved the large image of my cat into the two lower corners. Otherwise, the screen would have covered most of my first image.

### 2026-10-11 – October 11: Designed some art for my pet!

**0.88h**

October 11: Designed some art for my pet!

I couldn't get Lapse working on my iPad so here's some photos of my progress. I downloaded a pixel art app (Pixquare) and began a new 32x32 sketch.

My first idea was making a cat as my pet (which fits the graphics of my cat on the PCB). However, my first draft ended up looking more like a dog.

![IMG_1446](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/41cdf8854f998f8ad1fc2c0e23201ea3966fe269d5e3913904b98e34f93f3f60.png)

### 2026-10-11 – October 11: Finally finished (finished the firmware)

**2.3h**

October 11: Finally finished (finished the firmware)

I finished this project by adding some more unique functions. The first thing I thought would be cute would be to make a sweat drop appear when the temperature is too high and you shake the Starbie. So, I designed small sweat drop design. Then I added the code to make the sweat drop appear during the right conditions.

I updated the code in the provided simulator.html file from the guide to make sure it was all working.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WyN6YOeG4UtFVFQxcC7rI7Awh9i5F6xj/8092b23360f37639859bbfd1e675cf010a89b43066594a9759c5fe228e339028.png)
